The PKGBUILD is for a precompiled binary package of edirstat, distributed via the AUR. This is communicated clearly via a custom DLAGENTS entry that prints a note instructing the user to download the binary manually after purchase. This is not inherently malicious—only unconventional due to the non-free distribution model.

The package also downloads a public source tarball from GitHub to extract assets (icons, README, LICENSE), which is a common and acceptable practice in AUR packages to avoid duplicating static files. All source URLs are correctly specified, and checksums (sha512sums) are provided for all three sources, including the manually downloaded binary. The build process only involves installing the prebuilt binary, documentation, icons, and a desktop file—no compilation or untrusted scripts are executed.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized network requests, or suspicious file operations. The package depends only on standard system libraries, and optional dependencies are clearly marked. While the binary is not freely redistributable (due to itch.io distribution), this is a licensing issue, not a security one. The packaging follows AUR conventions and poses no supply-chain risk beyond trusting the upstream vendor.
</details>
